title: Coordinates of a Pair Encoding
statement: Let $u,v$ be binary strings and let $j\in\mathbb{N}$. The bit at position $j$ of their pair encoding, taking the default value $0$ when that position is beyond the end, is $u_{\lfloor j/2\rfloor}$ when $j<2|u|$, is $0$ when $j=2|u|$, is $1$ when $j=2|u|+1$, and is $v_{j-2|u|-2}$ when $j>2|u|+1$ (with out-of-range bits again taken to be $0$).
